include { FREEBAYES      } from 'nf-core/freebayes'
include { BCFTOOLS_SORT  } from 'nf-core/bcftools/sort'

workflow BAM_VARIANT_CALLING_SORT_FREEBAYES_BCFTOOLS {
    take:
    ch_input // channel: [mandatory] [ val(meta), path(input1), path(index1), path(input2), path(index2), path(bed) ]
    ch_fasta_fai // channel: [mandatory] [ val(meta2), path(fasta), path(fai) ]
    ch_samples // channel: [optional]  [ val(meta3), path(samples) ]
    ch_populations // channel: [optional]  [ val(meta4), path(populations) ]
    ch_cnv // channel: [optional]  [ val(meta5), path(cnv) ]

    main:
    // Variant calling
    FREEBAYES(
        ch_input,
        ch_fasta_fai.map { meta, fasta, _fai -> [meta, fasta] },
        ch_fasta_fai.map { meta, _fasta, fai -> [meta, fai] },
        ch_samples,
        ch_populations,
        ch_cnv,
    )

    // Sort VCF files
    BCFTOOLS_SORT(FREEBAYES.out.vcf)

    emit:
    vcf_index      = BCFTOOLS_SORT.out.vcf.join(BCFTOOLS_SORT.out.index) // channel: [ val(meta), path(vcf), path(index) ]
}

---
name: "nf-core/bam_variant_calling_sort_freebayes_bcftools"
description: "Call variants using freebayes, then sort and index"
keywords:
- "variant"
- "sort"
- "index"
- "bam"
- "cram"
- "vcf"
components:
- "freebayes"
- "bcftools/sort"
input:
- ch_input:
    type: "file"
    description: "Alignments to call variants from, where `input1` is a BAM/CRAM/SAM\
      \ file with its\nindex `index1`, `input2` is an optional second BAM/CRAM/SAM\
      \ file with its index\n`index2` used to run variant calling with a pair (normal\
      \ vs tumour), and `bed` is\nan optional BED file limiting the analysis to the\
      \ targets listed in it.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(input1), path(index1),\
      \ path(input2), path(index2), path(bed) ]\n"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference fasta file and its index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta2),\
      \ path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
- ch_samples:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional - Limit analysis to samples listed (one per line) in the\
      \ file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta3), path(samples) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- ch_populations:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional - Each line of the file should list a sample and a population\
      \ which it is part of.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta4), path(populations) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.txt"
- ch_cnv:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional - A copy number map BED file, which has either a sample-level\
      \ ploidy:\nsample_name copy_number\nor a region-specific format:\nseq_name start\
      \ end sample_name copy_number\n\nStructure: [ val(meta5), path(cnv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bed"
output:
- vcf_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Sorted VCF file with its index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(vcf),\
      \ path(index) ]\n"
authors:
- "@priyanka-surana"
- "@FriederikeHanssen"
- "@ramprasadn"
maintainers:
- "@priyanka-surana"
- "@FriederikeHanssen"
- "@ramprasadn"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/freebayes@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/bcftools/sort@0.0.0-df69bf6"
